repos_data.description: proxq - The honey badger of HTTP proxies. Takes your request, throws it in a Redis-backed job queue, and deals with it when it damn well pleases. You get a job ID back instantly — come back later to pick up the goods.
MCP server for inspecting and operating Redis-backed job queues (Asynq, BullMQ): per-state counts, job detail, retries, dead letters.
